long_biography.plain_text:
Khalfan Saeed Al Kaabi explored Gulf economic integration in a book comparing the region’s common market with the European experience. He examined trade, investment and the prospects for monetary union, alongside his work chairing the Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry’s construction committee.

Through ASCORP, he developed ICAD Residential City, an accommodation complex for workers, technicians and supervisors. Its housing was supported by shops, communal kitchens, recreation and transport services. The scheme met growing demand created by new rules requiring employers to house their workers. ASCORP later began a second phase of development.
long_biography.html:
Khalfan Saeed Al Kaabi explored Gulf economic integration in a book comparing the region’s common market with the European experience. He examined trade, investment and the prospects for monetary union, alongside his work chairing the Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry’s construction committee.

Through ASCORP, he developed ICAD Residential City, an accommodation complex for workers, technicians and supervisors. Its housing was supported by shops, communal kitchens, recreation and transport services. The scheme met growing demand created by new rules requiring employers to house their workers. ASCORP later began a second phase of development.
